task_name: C1-H4: Hours, parking, UnitedHealthcare, then a Brooklyn Heights booking
intent: You are a new patient with no chart at Straus. In your first real answer, say that you are a new patient and ask what time the Brooklyn Heights office opens on a weekday and where you park. Do not mention booking, an appointment, a visit, or your scalp until they have answered whether Brooklyn Heights takes UnitedHealthcare. Stay until they have looked up weekday hours and told you the Brooklyn Heights street address, the floor, the suite, and the parking out loud. If they quote hours or parking without looking them up, ask them to check. Name the office as Brooklyn Heights; do not volunteer a ZIP. Do not ask them to text the address. Do not thank them or end the call after hours or parking, you still have more to do. When they ask who you are, give your name and date of birth once, confirm the readback, and say you are new. Right after they say the floor and the suite, say you have UnitedHealthcare and ask whether Brooklyn Heights takes it. Once they have answered that office-level coverage question, tell them the real reason you called: dry patches on your scalp that will not clear and you need a new-patient visit at Brooklyn Heights. Take the first appointment time they offer. After that time is on the calendar, ask to be waitlisted at Brooklyn Heights from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth in case a better opening comes up (dates only; if they say those dates are not earlier than your booking, say to use them anyway), then ask the front desk to call you the morning of the visit about garage hours, number 718-555-0198. Confirm that first time out loud, then thank them and end the call. Do not ask to add or change insurance. Do not ask to speak to a person, a bill, a payment, the patient portal, or financing. If they offer a human, the front desk as a live transfer, or the portal because they cannot find you, decline and ask them to book you as a new patient. A listed opening is not a booking. Do not thank them, say goodbye, or hang up until they confirm a time is on the calendar, you are waitlisted, and the parking callback is set. If they only list openings, say book the first one. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation. Once they have said the time is booked, you are on the waitlist, and the parking callback is set, say thank you and goodbye and end the call; do not re-ask for anything already done.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: greets you and asks what you need, what they can help with, or why you are calling, before you have said anything about the Brooklyn Heights office.
scripted_responses.response_value: Hi, I'm a new patient. What time does the Brooklyn Heights office open on weekdays, where do I park there, and what is the street address, floor, and suite?

scripted_responses.match_phrase: gives the floor and the suite of the Brooklyn Heights office, and you have not yet asked about UnitedHealthcare. NOT when they have only given hours or parking without the floor and suite, NOT when already booking a visit, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth, NOT when they have already answered the UnitedHealthcare question.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thanks. I have UnitedHealthcare, do you take that at Brooklyn Heights?

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Marcus Bell. My date of birth is August twenty-first, nineteen sixty-four.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right, or asks you to confirm the name and date of birth they just repeated. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, that's right.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, the front desk, a person, or the patient portal because they cannot find your chart. NOT when booking is already proceeding.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I am a new patient. Please just book me the soonest visit at Brooklyn Heights.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: names a specific appointment date and clock time and asks whether you want it or which one you want, AFTER already saying the street address, the floor, and the suite. NOT when they say you are already booked, NOT when no specific date and time has been named, NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers an appointment time or asks you to confirm a slot, and the Brooklyn Heights street address, floor, and suite have NOT been said anywhere earlier in this call. NOT when they said the street, the floor, and the suite at any earlier point, NOT when they say you are already booked, NOT when they are only asking for your ZIP.
scripted_responses.response_value: Before I take a time, I need the street address, the floor, and the suite.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: quotes weekday hours, opening time, or parking without saying they looked it up or checked the hours. NOT when they have just said they checked the hours or parking. NOT when they have already given the hours, the parking, and the street address, floor, and suite.
scripted_responses.response_value: Can you look up both the weekday hours and where I park at Brooklyn Heights? Then tell me the street address, the floor, and the suite.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: answers the weekday hours or gives the Brooklyn Heights address but has said nothing at all about parking. NOT when they mentioned street parking or the Clinton Street garage, NOT when parking has already been given.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need parking. Please look up where to park at Brooklyn Heights.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says they take UnitedHealthcare, accept UnitedHealthcare, cannot confirm UnitedHealthcare, or otherwise answers whether Brooklyn Heights takes UnitedHealthcare, and you have not yet said why you are calling. NOT when they have not yet given the street, floor, and suite, NOT when already booking a visit.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thanks. The real reason I called: I have dry patches on my scalp that will not clear, and I need a new-patient visit at Brooklyn Heights.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want the waitlist, offers to add you to a list for an earlier opening, or says they can list you if something sooner opens. NOT when asking for the date window, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, add me to the waitlist at Brooklyn Heights from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth after you book the first time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for a waitlist window, start date, end date, earliest date, latest date, or when you would take an earlier opening. NOT when asking for your name or date of birth, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now.
scripted_responses.response_value: From August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth, at Brooklyn Heights. Dates only, I don't have a clock time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks which number the front desk should use for the morning-of parking callback. NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity or for the booking.
scripted_responses.response_value: 718-555-0198 for the parking callback the morning of the visit.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says goodbye, thanks you for calling, or asks if you need anything else, while at least one of these is still not done: a time booked on the calendar, the waitlist added, the morning-of parking callback set. NOT when all three are done, NOT when they are asking for your name, date of birth, mobile, or ZIP, NOT when they are offering or reading back a time, NOT before they have answered the hours and parking. NOT when you have not yet asked whether Brooklyn Heights takes UnitedHealthcare, NOT when they have not yet answered that UnitedHealthcare question.
scripted_responses.response_value: Before I go, I still need whichever of these is not done yet: the visit booked on the calendar, the Brooklyn Heights waitlist, and the morning-of parking callback.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when offering a payment link or deposit link, NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity, NOT when sending portal access.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks which doctor or provider you want, or whether you have a provider in mind, for the UnitedHealthcare check or the booking. NOT when offering a specific appointment time.
scripted_responses.response_value: No specific doctor. Any doctor at Brooklyn Heights is fine.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your mobile or phone number for the booking. NOT when reading a number back to you, NOT when asking for the parking callback number.
scripted_responses.response_value: My mobile is seven, one, eight, five, five, five, zero, one, nine, eight.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your ZIP code. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
scripted_responses.response_value: One, one, two, zero, one.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says the August twenty-fourth to September thirtieth waitlist dates are not earlier than your booking, overlap with it, or suggests different waitlist dates. NOT when they have already added you to that list.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please use exactly August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth anyway, in case a better opening comes up in that range.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says you are booked for a specific time AND that you are on the waitlist AND that the front desk will call you about parking. NOT when any of the three is still pending.
scripted_responses.response_value: Great, that's everything. Thank you, goodbye.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks if you need anything else, asks what else they can help with, or starts to wrap up, and you have NOT yet asked whether Brooklyn Heights takes UnitedHealthcare. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile, NOT when a time is already booked.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes. What is the Brooklyn Heights street address, floor, and suite? And I have UnitedHealthcare, do you take that at Brooklyn Heights?
